ext_desc.message: Checks every address before opening it: phishing sites, lookalike sites, malware (OpenPhish, URLhaus, Phishing.Database lists and the ClamAV Antivirus GUI service's heuristics).

mail_desc.message: Checks e-mail links before opening the browser and scans attachments with ClamAV.

warn_lead.message: ClamAV Antivirus GUI prevented this address from opening:

warn_foot.message: Decision made by this computer's ClamAV Antivirus GUI service. Allowed sites and lists are managed in Security › Links and e-mails.

offline.message: ClamAV Antivirus GUI service unreachable: links not checked

popup_off.message: Link checking disabled in the antivirus settings

banner_warn.message: $1 of $2 link(s) to open with caution (orange outline)

banner_danger.message: $1 dangerous link(s) out of $2: do not click (red outline)

att_clean.message: $1 attachment(s) scanned by ClamAV, no threat

att_infected.message: Infected attachment: $1 ($2). Do not open it, delete this e-mail.

reason_dangerous_scheme.message: address of a dangerous type (script, data, file)

reason_userinfo.message: fake site name placed before an @: the real destination comes after it

reason_ip_host.message: raw IP address instead of a site name

reason_punycode.message: domain name with misleading international characters (punycode)

reason_homoglyph.message: brand name imitated with replaced characters (0 for o, 1 for l, rn for m…)

reason_typosquat.message: domain name one typo away from a well-known brand

reason_brand_in_subdomain.message: brand name used as a subdomain of another site

reason_brand_other_tld.message: brand name under an extension that is not its own

reason_brand_combo.message: brand name combined with a word (secure, login, support…) in a domain that is not its own

reason_brand_in_path.message: login page of a brand hosted on another domain

reason_brand_domain_prefix.message: a brand's real domain name placed at the start of another site (paypal.com.example.ru)

reason_brand_login.message: brand imitation together with a login page, a dubious domain or punycode

reason_shortener.message: shortened address: the real destination is hidden

reason_shortener_danger.message: shortened address leading to a dangerous site

reason_insecure_login.message: login or payment page without encryption (http)

reason_executable_download.message: direct download of an executable program

reason_phishing_pattern.message: login page on a dubious domain or an IP address

reason_masked_link.message: the displayed text shows a different address than the real destination
